headline: UK to ban pornography depicting strangulation and incest from November
summary: The UK government announced that pornography depicting choking or strangulation and incest will be banned in England and Wales from 6 November, following a 2025 review into pornography regulation led by Baroness Gabby Bertin and sustained cross-party pressure. Campaigners welcomed the new legislation.
